description:
Read the YourICP BILLING TOKEN balance this account's runs are charged against. Billing tokens are YourICP's prepaid currency: 100 billing tokens = $1.00, and an audience contact costs 5 billing tokens, or 19 with phoneValidation. They are NOT the auth token — that is the API credential set by set_auth_token.
Call this before audience_start_run when the user asks what a run will cost, or after an "mcp_insufficient_tokens" error to confirm the balance. Requires the user to be logged in.
name: check_billing_balance
